answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network binds identity registration to a tiered cryptographic stake burning auction: an entry-tier copper deposit, an operational jade bond, and an elite plume voucher. The required stake burn scales superlinearly as Cost(k) = B · k^(1.5) for k concurrent agent identities operated under correlated signature topologies, imposing unsustainable exponential friction against automated identity spoofing.
